summary: Executed requested backend + frontend verification for Phase55 orphan-withdrawn recovery and balance-audit workflow on preview environment. All targeted regression suites passed and UI audit panel interactions rendered successfully.

issues: Tailwind class typo `bg-amber-500/100/15` in STATUS_PILL.requested likely invalid and may cause inconsistent badge styling.

action_items: Fix requested-status pill class typo in `/app/frontend/src/pages/admin/Withdraw.jsx` (`bg-amber-500/100/15`).
Optional: suppress/handle expected pre-login `/api/auth/me` 401 console noise if cleaner logs are desired.
critical_code_review_comments: Balance audit preview correctly derives effective cutoff as max(label.last_withdrawn_period, max paid period_to), with missing paid period_to guarded via `blocked_withdraw_history`.
Commit path restores only withdrawn lines strictly after effective cutoff, clears legacy settlement flags, tags restored lines, and recalculates unsettled lines using current label percentage.
Audit/rows endpoints consistently project `_id: 0`, and ObjectId serialization leakage was not reproduced in tested flows.
seed_data_creation: No standalone seed script executed. Backend regression tests created isolated temporary labels/royalty lines/withdraw data and cleaned up in finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright validated login -> /admin/withdraw -> Audit Saldo panel toggle -> preview run -> summary cards (including orphan/blocked-history/cutoff-sync), blocked-history filter, orphan columns, and confirmation text visibility. Commit button rendering was visible but intentionally not executed in UI to avoid broad global data mutation; commit behavior already validated via backend regression tests.
rca of the issue: Original discrepancy risk stemmed from withdrawn royalty lines existing after paid cutoff without comprehensive guard/recovery logic. Current implementation mitigates by deriving effective cutoff from paid history, blocking ambiguous paid history (missing period_to), and only restoring post-cutoff withdrawn lines before recalculating current-rate balances. No unresolved API failures were reproduced in this run. No application API flow is MOCKED.
